name: THE TUNING FORK
note: Doc 01: his one tool, the game's totem, never leaves the inventory -- so it starts in it and there is no puzzle that gives it to him. LOOK and LISTEN are verbatim from docs/10-examine-batch-3.md. The repeat variants are the doc 05 Room 1 pair for the same object, which is the only other place it is written; a third variant for each is NOT written anywhere and is not invented here.

LOOK_AT.say: My father thought this was a sensible investment. He was, on the evidence, the only person in my family who has ever been right about anything.
repeat: Everything I own, and a tuning fork. The tuning fork is the valuable part.

LISTEN_TO.say: A. Four hundred and forty. It is still the only correct thing within a hundred miles.
repeat: The fork, faintly, against the clasp. A. Four hundred and forty. It is the only correct thing within a hundred miles.
